args.title: Handle multiple empty lines in parseStatement
args.body:
File: src/ingest/parser.ts

Ensure the parseStatement function correctly handles multiple empty lines by stripping all trailing empty lines, not just the last one. This prevents any empty line from being misinterpreted as a data row, which can trigger a 'Malformed row' error in the assertShape function.

label: bug
file: src/ingest/parser.ts
This comment was written by RepoMind, an automated triage agent. To reach a person, mention @ledgerline/maintainers.

The function `parseStatement` in `src/ingest/parser.ts` attempts to remove the last line if empty with `if (lines.length > 0 && lines[lines.length - 1] === "") lines.pop();`. However, if the input has multiple empty lines, an empty line can be misinterpreted as a data row, triggering a 'Malformed row' error in the `assertShape` function.
